sharedStoryClusters.story: French Unrest and Curfews Imposed in Paris and Nice
sharedStoryClusters.summary: Following severe nationwide riots, looting, and widespread arrests over living costs, French authorities implemented localized nighttime curfews across major cities including Paris and Nice. Courts initiated hasty trials for arrested individuals amid extensive business property damage, tourist disruptions, and high schooler detentions, while France's 10-year bond yield hit 5% for the first time since 2002.
sharedStoryClusters.developmentNote: France 24 reports partial nighttime curfews enacted across Paris and Nice following widespread riots.
